steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're hurt?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't worry. Just a scratch.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How is that just a scratch? Come here, I have disinfectant wipes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Look, I'm fine...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Turn your face this way!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine, fine.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ...The wound is deep, but not very wide. It's as if... there's a trace of Arts.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ...Did old Ch'en do this to you? That blasted woman...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hah... It's fine. Girls of her age are bound to do stuff like this.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ...Hoshiguma, I'm really scared. I'm scared that she'll...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That she'll join Reunion?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I also played with Talulah when I was young.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Even though I don't remember very clearly, I do know... that I really liked being her friend.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Even if she was bossy and had a temper, she always stood up for us.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: She never said anything, but she never backed down. She was always the first to charge ahead, and never asked us for help...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: She beat up kids who were older than her. She was the only one who could get Ch'en to snap out of her funks.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm afraid that...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: She won't.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm telling you, Ch'en's heart is rarely on the same page as her mouth.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But, she will always be Ch'en of Lungmen. No matter what she might say, all her dreams, all her goals, her entire life... has always been right here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: So, why'd you try to stop her then?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I was worried she'd get herself killed. Obviously.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Swire, you'll have an important role in the L.G.D. after this.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: As if I could do that. I'm not her...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, so you're admitting she's better than you?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I just don't think I'm cut out for the L.G.D.!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, Missy, you absolutely are.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not cut out for it. Neither is ol' Ch'en. Or Nine.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The one who really makes the L.G.D. shine... is you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You have to take responsibility. You're the only one who can do it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm jaded now, and there's a lot I don't see. I just want this city to become a place that accepts everyone.
I feel the same.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's been a long time, Miss Swire.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Hello, Inspector Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why is the esteemed daughter of the Rat King at this run-down place?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What are you planning to do to her? Let me say this, if you're planning to harm even a single hair on Missy's head...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I have no such intentions.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You... screwed up.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Sometimes, we have no choice.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I don't think there's ever a time... where we don't have a choice.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Look up in the sky.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's going to snow. Can you choose for it to stop?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Why... is it snowing?
Go to sleep, go to sleep♪
Daddy's grey hair, Mommy's needles♪

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Crap, we're exceeding the solubility threshold! Manually release the exhaust valve, now!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That bout of volatility just caused a violent heat-absorbing effect. If we don't increase emissions, the entire cabin's going to be ruined!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The rainclouds haven't moved much either... At this rate, we're in for some major snow.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: This FrostNova... what kind of person was she?
All dreams sink to the bottom of the lake~♪
...'tis a reality that even time cannot shake~♪

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Damnit... What an ugly song.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Damn it!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Why was FrostNova so good at it? I really... can't sing well...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's snowing...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: This old man...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: His crystallization rate is over sixty percent now. Even a Sarkaz shouldn't be able to move.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: His consciousness has already dissipated... However, his iron will continues to ripple from his body.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Resentment. Hatred. Remorse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's all gone now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The only thing that's left is wrath.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The unwillingness to accept FrostNova's fate. The hostility towards Talulah's actions. The endless longing for Ursus and Kazdel...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A fiery and unquenchable wrath. For all the injustice around the world. For all those who fell around him... Towards those that would play with the fates of others.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To resist fate is to resist everything. Everything that contributes to the idea of 'destiny.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee's wrath... scorched this entire world.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...This entire, injustice-filled world.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Mr. Patriot...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Move your hand.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You, Cautus Infected.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...We will complete the Captain's unfinished business.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...It's enough.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Do you want him to die for nothing?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: He didn't want any of you to die. He wanted all of you to find another path.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: He chose to die alone so that all of you could live...!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Who said we'll be the ones who die?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And we also heard what he said.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Cautus. You're the source of all the ruin to come.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The ancient prophecies have all been fulfilled.

options: But FrostNova put her faith in us!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Still...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: FrostNova... and now even the Captain...

options: Of course he wouldn't just buy into FrostNova's assessment!
He just happened to ignore his daughter's opinion...
He didn't go into any of this on blind faith.
The decision he made... is truly just!
And you choose to believe some prophecy?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...No, it's not that we believe in the prophecy.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We believe in the Captain.

options: ...FrostNova's candy was spicy.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...What?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Yelena... let you try her candy?

options: I trusted her, and she trusted me.
If you really want to take someone's life...
At least be there to see it yourself!
Don't blindly follow someone else!
You must follow your own will until the bitter end.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Rhodes Island, we get some of what you're saying. But we'll never see eye-to-eye.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We've followed the Captain our entire lives, but we we didn't do it blindly.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If... one day, that Cautus girl there turns into a tyrant like Talulah...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We will end you.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The Captain fought against all those people... against slavers, oppressors, corrupt rulers, and those who brought ruin. None could escape.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The Captain knew. About all the people in Chernobog who lost their lives to the Catastrophe. About all our battle brothers who died in vain.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: He had his regrets, but knew he couldn't escape. He has set us free now, though. We belong only to the Captain and the ideals he fought for, not to Reunion.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We will take up his 'Aegis' from now on. Not as the Aegis of the Infected, but as defenders of all the enslaved.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We'll keep an eye on you, Cautus. If you take even a single step onto the wrong path, we swear to hunt you down.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We will treat these prophecies... as our secrets.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Because before that, we have a tyrant waiting for us in the control tower.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...The person who pushed you into a war against us and brought about this chain of tragedies is the leader of Reunion, Talulah.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We're going to regroup. We need to tell the guerrillas the news.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: As for you... Continue to carry out your mission, if that's what you want.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Snow... flakes...?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: This heavy snow... Is Yelena coming to pick up the Captain...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, don't be too concerned about it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Sarkaz people have a long history with Originium. Their memories mix with Originium and become one with the land, returning to their own bodies.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sometimes, certain tribes that have long passed down these Originium crystals will gather this information in one place.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Through the continuous use of Arts, this information, mixed together unexpectedly, manifests in different ways.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Most of these messages are lost to time, their contents jumbled or outdated. There is no basis for these prophecies.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, they directly affect other people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Like... someone hears these prophecies and starts to try to fulfill them, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't tell if these ideas are just vague whispers... or seeds that can bloom into reality. I really can't tell, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He could have killed me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... he thought...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I'll kill her now.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Stop. How are you so sure that she's our enemy?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: She is Kashchey's heir! She'll poison us all, just like that old serpent!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No, you stubborn old man... You're wrong.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even if she's bound to turn out like that in the end, we can't kill her now.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because she's not Kashchey right now. Eh, who even is that? I can't understand you. All I know is, she's just Talulah.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...Who put these ideas in your head? It will twist your will to fight.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Twist? ...As if, old man. This whole idea of a pure warrior's spirit? If you really had that, I never would've met you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you really had that, we wouldn't be able to sit around a fire and have soup like we are now.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You're... just sixteen.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Did your soup get cold?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Always been cold. It's better that way.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I'll listen to you this time.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No, Father. That's not how it works.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you believe you're right, then... no matter what happens, you should keep on believing that.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Because if something happens to Talulah, that's between her and her people.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But reality is just what's in front of us. Right, Father?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No matter what the future has in store, right now, I am I, and you are you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No matter how much you dwell on it, we are who we are today. The only ones who we can change are ourselves, and we are the ones who will make that decision.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Let's try walking her path and see what happens.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: ...You'll be a great leader in the future.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I don't want to become a leader. I just want a comfortable life with my brothers and sisters, my uncles and aunts, and you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I'll remember that.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I won't forget.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... Dr. Kal'tsit... Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...He could've killed me... Mr. Buldrokkas'tee... could have killed me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I saw... I saw what he was thinking.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He didn't do it. He stopped himself, at the end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can still... hear him...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Tell me the most important thing. What was the last thing he said?
'I have seen. Woe and tragedy.'
'I have seen. Death and carnage.'
'I have seen. Neglect and blasphemy.'
'But someone once told me. It is all in our hands. If in the future, this is all that awaits us...'
'O, little King of Sarkaz. It is all in our hands. If this is fate...'
'Then I reject it.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He said... He asked...
He sighed...
'My Lord... Where will you go?'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Then nothing more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... I've read it all. I've seen everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I read his entire life.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Buldrokkas'tee... He admitted that he betrayed his convictions twice in his life.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The first, was when he left Kazdel and walked away from his life as a Sarkaz warrior.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The second, was when he stood up against Ursus and walked away from his life as a warrior of the Ursus Empire.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And just now... I'd say he made his final betrayal. He betrayed Reunion and the Infected he served, and stopped being a warrior of the Reunion Movement.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: With his death ends his last act of betrayal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He betrayed everything he cared about, because he has always stood up for his beliefs.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But this... isn't right, is it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This kind of 'sublime betrayal' is a sort of release for those who deceive the world. It is an easy way to move things towards the best outcome.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But not for Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you mean that...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Speak up, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Kazdel is Mr. Buldrokkas'tee's home.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though he's come so far, he's always wanted to go back to Kazdel... It's not that he didn't want to go back home, but that he couldn't. He had to pay the price first... for his betrayal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ursus is his motherland. He fought for Ursus all his life... and blamed himself for the death of his son.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He believed that Ursus was evil, but for the sake of this land, he gave his life... fighting until the very end. He also paid the price for his second betrayal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This time... he had to stand up against Talulah. But he foresaw that some of the people he strove to protect would die because of his actions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though the decision he made preserved a future for the Infected, he... only felt pain... for the deceased.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is his third act of betrayal, and the reason he was so determined to atone for it. From beginning to end, this battle was to make up for the consequences of his betrayal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Through these three times, fate ended up pushing him further and further when he just wanted to turn back. He hated the cruelty and mockery of fate. He never wanted to follow it, but he bore the consequences for it all the same.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ten years, twenty years... I'd be able to understand. But... too much time had passed. After facing all those regrets for so many years, too much time had passed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At the very end, even I could not understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He could've taken my life, but he stopped at the end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...He defeated his lifetime of suffering, his centuries-old ideology, and his love for this entire world.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He no longer followed the principles he had adhered to for countless years. He... succumbed to fate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, saying that would defile his memory. Rather, he chose to ignore everything he had been resisting, and overcame the final obstacle within his own heart.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He entrusted the future to you. This time, he gladly chose to do what he thought was right, rather than torture himself to maintain a certain ideal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course, deep in his heart, this part is as you described...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It once belonged to Talulah, and now belongs to you. But it has always belonged to FrostNova.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Patriot... FrostNova...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit. Rosmontis... and Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will end this war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right here. Right now.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll be with you, Amiya. Always.
Even if you can save many people, you'll cause immense suffering.
Anger. My anger comes from the injustice that fate has dealt to this world.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After countless years... are things finally coming to a head?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: How could something like that happen? This prophecy... is it not just another fragment of Sarkaz history?
Core City Warehouse District

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Why is one of Patriot's men over here? This isn't your patrol area.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: You, let him go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Ngh...!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I'll let it slide this time. A little warning, don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong next time.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: I just received news.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: ...Patriot has passed away.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: That's some big news.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: So, right now... we have no more reason to keep up this charade.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Your band of devils smells far worse than any of our Sarkaz.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: What happened? How did Patriot die?!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Take care of this Reunion scum first!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You're picking a fight with the core city?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: What's wrong with that?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Even Patriot is dead. You bastards... I won't tolerate you any longer!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If Patriot is dead, then what value does Reunion even have?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Guerrillas! If there's anything I can do to help... tell me!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: First, we're going to throw everyone who would toy with the lives of the Infected... right off these city walls!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mantra-2, put on the uniform. Closure has already hacked the identification code, so make sure not to reveal your hidden weapons.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: News of the incident should have spread already. What we need now is...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Chaos?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, order. Go help the guerrillas. Let the Infected, the well-intentioned Reunion members, and those who fight against injustice rally under one banner.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just as if Talulah was unable to engineer Patriot's death.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What...? What? What did he say?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Patriot is dead!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: The one who was truly looking out for Reunion! The one who fought for all of us! Patriot is dead!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Talulah orchestrated this conspiracy against Patriot! ...She's an agent of Ursus!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Who'd believe your nonsense?!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Wait... Talulah has been acting strangely. She gave an order forbidding us from maintaining communications in the city.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What does that prove?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: It proves... that the mercenaries are going to ambush the guerrillas! I see their plan... those lunatics!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Stop! Don't fight us, if you value your lives. Otherwise, we'll destroy you!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: We are the Aegis of the Infected, and we'll battle every last enemy for our peoples! Even if we have to stand against Talulah!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: For Patriot!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: For Patriot!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Things have gotten a bit messy. You should leave soon.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Us mercs have our own priorities. We don't care about Talulah's plots. Do your best, and live on.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: For the future of the Infected!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: For...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...Captain Faust!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: For all our comrades who've been betrayed by Talulah! For Faust!
Patriot is dead! Patriot is dead! Talulah betrayed Patriot! Talulah betrayed us all!
Are you sure it wasn't an outsider that killed him? I saw someone else kill him, not Talulah!
Patriot plotted with the Ursus Army to try to kill the Leader! Open your eyes and see the truth! Patriot is the traitor!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Patriot must have foreseen this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But, his struggle against the storm was in vain. Even the 'Aegis' have adopted his most radical ideas, and not his pragmatic approach.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After all this, the core city should descend into chaos. The Reunion Movement no longer exists.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, is this the revenge you wanted?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, not yet. Not like this. I haven't seen the target yet. No...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter who you face, the outcome is the same.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reunion is just a symbol. No matter who is caught up in it or what they do... they are not an individual. They act as a part of Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Revenge... will only get you this far. We cannot distinguish their faces. We can only eliminate the symbol itself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, you can continue to carry out your wishes. But... do you find this kind of vengeance satisfying?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... I just...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would be irresponsible of me to give you the answer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only you have the ability to pursue the things that you hold to be true. Rosmontis, I might not be the person who can answer that question.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Anger is entrenched into our bodies. Do we want to indulge ourselves, to let it flow and condense into hatred?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or, can we turn it into a higher judge that measures all our future actions and illuminates our sanity?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you want to distinguish between right and wrong, or do you want to understand the reason why everything happens?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The lives and deaths of our operators, the sights that shake you... and the reasons why we feel these emotions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if there are certain things that your mind erases, Rosmontis, they will always remain within you...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe there are very few things in our lives that actually come down to right or wrong. Remove all these symbols, and only then do our lives have value.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I want to know the reason.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}. We'll split up for the next part.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis and I will go to the control tower. Dr. Kal'tsit will take you to the generator area.

options: I won't see you for a while?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just a few hours, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: By the way, Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if I'm not at your side, I'll always know that Dr. {@nickname} is out there... fighting together with me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even out of sight, we still fight for the same goal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm pretty happy with that.

options: See you after the mission!
Goodbye.
Later, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madame Ch'en may already be near the command tower. She's always been quick, so we'll have to pick up our pace.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Promise me that you'll stay safe.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our work here only means anything if we make it back to Rhodes Island safely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Be careful, okay?

options: You too.

steps.text: Chernobog Core City, Power Supply Sector

options: Why'd you pick me for your team?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our decapitation strike team will be attacked by Reunion from all directions as they approach the control tower. I can't just drop you off in a battlefield like that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When we were fighting the guerrillas, we could retreat and buy ourselves time to regroup. That won't be possible for their team. They won't even have an opening to catch their breaths.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This battle has a clear objective, and Amiya and Rosmontis's team can no longer afford any distractions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You'll be safe with me.

options: I don't feel safe around you.
You're not staying with Amiya?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We should only take on responsibilities that we can fulfill.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After entering the sarcophagus, our communications will only further deteriorate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At that time, we will truly be fighting alone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, please stay hidden for a while.

options: Why?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...If you don't want to, or if you're feeling claustrophobic, I won't stop you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ah... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where am I? How'd I blast my way down here... Is this it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh? You're...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island? What rotten luck I have today...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hm?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...What an unexpected reunion, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You're gravely wounded.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you go by now, W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Still W. Didn't have time to change it yet.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hold up, why are you casually milling around a place like this? Don't tell me...

steps.name: W
steps.text: The old man's gone, huh?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: W
steps.text: He died? How is that possible?

steps.name: W
steps.text: But... then again, he wasn't going to survive this. He never backs down, and never lets anyone through.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You sound a bit heartbroken.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Guess so.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That old fella was the only person who made me even give Reunion a second look.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Guess today... was that idealist's last.

options: He died a glorious death!
You don't understand anything.
Are you serious?
I saw him draw his last breath.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Kal'tsit, story time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do I have something to tell you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're asking me? You kidding? How do you have the nerve to stand there all calm like nothing ever happened?
The Sarkaz woman glares at me with eyes that I had never seen before.
Though she directs her words at Dr. Kal'tsit, her eyes are fixed on me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Kal'tsit, you're working with Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You? Working together with Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is there a problem, W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Of course, assuming you're not like this bastard here pretending you don't remember anything. But if that's true, guess it doesn't matter...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Otherwise, your brain cells got fried by one of your weird experiments.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well shit, either I'm the crazy one, or you are. But even if I am crazy, that doesn't make you any less of a loon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're still clear-headed, W. Let's save the small talk for some other time.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't wanna. What even happened? Just looking at you makes me want to puke.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But even if I'm trying not to throw up, this is just too funny.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Kal'tsit, you finally went bonkers too. Trying to tame the evil spirit of Babel?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Can't prove there are any memories left in this one's head. We're just working together for the time being.

steps.name: W
steps.text: This so-called amnesia... How are you so sure that it's not all an elaborate act?

steps.name: W
steps.text: It might have everyone fooled. Yes, everyone. You're fooled too, whether or not you want to admit it... That's the scorecard I got.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Kal'tsit, you're a monster, aren't you? A monster so smart you got a big, bright, glowy brain.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And a monster should know better than me what happens when you have another monster around.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are too many creatures in this world that can be called 'monsters.' Throw the word around too much and it'll end up losing all meaning.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or, you've just gone mad. That's a whole different matter.

options: What exactly do you know?

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's no place for you to cut in here, friend. When I finish with her, it'll be time for the two of us to have a nice, long chat.

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's no point taking things out on you. Either you have amnesia, or you're just pretending to have amnesia...

steps.name: W
steps.text: But this woman next to you is totally out of her mind.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I want to know—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Back then, there was only one person who entered the Speaker's Office and knew Theresa's whereabouts. Kal'tsit, you know what that means, don't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course. I know it better than you do.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Those were your words!

steps.name: W
steps.text: So what's the deal? What are you doing now?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, I get it. You're trying to make another exchange. Tit-for-tat.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But it's Theresa on the other end!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Those who don't know the truth shouldn't let conjecture affect their emotions, W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I have just a single conjecture: You aren't human. Like I said before, if you'll bargain Theresa's death with a murderer... you're just a monster.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're not human, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I need to know the truth. And before I do, that thing next to you is a murderer; and I'll never show mercy to a murderer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ahh, I get it now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're bursting with motherly love, huh.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: W, you said before...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'We're the same type of person.'

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't know where you heard that before, you should pretend you never did. You and I are not the same type of creature at all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, W. We are, to some extent.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For example, you also want to put an end to Talulah's atrocities, correct?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...That's true. She's really pissed me off.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, I need to get my merc back from her. That piece of shit only knows how to squander her people. Such a spendthrift. I'm worried she'll blow all our savings and leave me penniless.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right, so let's deal with the Reunion problem first.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sure. I got my targets. Wanna hear?

steps.name: W
steps.text: First is Talulah, that disgusting dragon lady upstairs.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Next is Theresis, the one that makes you want to sneeze as soon as you see him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Those are some long-term plans.

steps.name: W
steps.text: After that, the third I thing I want to kill is standing right next to you: Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're only third on the list?

options: I'm only in third place?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah. That's because I have something to ask you first, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I got some some long, thorough explanations to pull out of you...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At this stage, we have a common goal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: By the way, because of what you did to our employees in Chernobog...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: First, thanks for saving the lives of Dr. {@nickname} and the rescue team with your deal. Your 'deal' cost us thirteen of our operators.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Balancing these two things, I'm willing to give you a lift, for old time's sake. I'll take you to the command tower.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Kal'tsit... You really know how to gross a girl out.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I've always found you disgusting. I'll have to rearrange your face a little first, see which one of us comes out on top...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Howls)

steps.name: W
steps.text: You bitch!

options: Mon3tr just grabbed her... and tossed her out like a ragdoll?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't have time to play with her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, blast through the ventilation pipes, the walls, and the base's outer and middle protective layers along with her.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You old hag!! N-n-n-n-next time, I swear I'm giving you a slow and painful d————

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm looking forward to it.

options: I'm surprised you let her finish her first sentence.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not like you can understand it.

options: Why don't you explain it to me then?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's not time yet.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When you see for yourself, you should understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Secrets are like wellsprings. Sometimes they will flow out, whether you want them to or not.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What a strange device.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Where are you taking me?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Will you fill the holes in my body, or mend my scars?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Will you let me forget everything, just like the other one did for me, before?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If I was to forget everything...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Do I want to forget?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I want...
Can I make that choice?
Core City

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...What's going on? Dark clouds? It's snowing?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But, it's also covered the sun for me. This'll make my next step a lot easier.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ugh... I can't afford to take any more hits.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tch... Are you scared of shedding a little blood, Ch'en Hui-chieh? What happened to your determination?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There seems to be infighting among Reunion's ranks. This is the best time for me to move.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are my hands trembling because I'm finally going to see you again?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I must do what is right.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It doesn't matter what you are now, whether or not you're the same Talulah I knew.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talulah... we have a date.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The snow sure is coming down hard...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Just like... that one Christmas.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You've never spoken to me about that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But you already know.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Me knowing and you telling me are two separate things.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Princess, let's not embarrass Missy over here.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Let's drop that title, Princess.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Madame Oni, the Lin family will never forget all you've done.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But right now, I don't know if there will be an opportunity to reward you for it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What are you talking about? Of course you can.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: She... I know she'll succeed.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ah Ch'en...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Look at you, where'd all your willpower go?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah, what are you gonna do? Missy has always been like that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Now now, Missy, there's no need to cry.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You... Stop treating me like a child...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't worry. Everything is going to be fine.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But... this is the last time we'll see each other. I'm not ready yet... What if... I never see that smelly dragon again?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That won't happen, Missy.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's this phrase that I really like. Mm, it goes like this: 'We'll meet again someday, somewhere.'

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: ...Yes. And when we look back at each other again, we will ask about our lives.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What's going on? Where are these tears coming from?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's as if... someone just told me about a death.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Everything in the core city has been unfolding according to my plan.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Patriot will die by the hands of the Infected, and the Sarkaz mercenaries will start fighting the ordinary Reunion forces.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Patriot is dead? So it was Patriot.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: A true warrior. Such a name was not enough to describe you. Ursus itself was too small for your greatness.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: A patriot to the very end.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Why am I crying? Is it out of nostalgia, or a courtesy to those who want to kill me?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: 'All sins must come to an end?'

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Then we shall see. If we are the sinners, then we will inevitably meet our end...
But I shall wait for you at that end.                      But I shall wait for her at that end.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Why are you here, Kojui?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Just like all those decades ago. When people get anxious, they make stupid decisions, and they end up pacing around here.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Funny, isn't it? Still haven't kicked this old habit after all these years.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Do you know what I'm going to do, Kojui?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I do happen to know. All thanks to that niece of yours, of course. You two are both cut from the same cloth of stupidity.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Kojui, you're not out here on a stroll. Even if you were, you shouldn't waste my time.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Is it ever a waste of time to talk to an old friend?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Do you not consider me a friend anymore, Wei Yenwu?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If you do, promise me...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I can't. I won't promise you anything.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: So be it. You're not going anywhere today.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Don't think too highly of yourself.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That's what I should be saying to you. Wei Yenwu, you've been up in that tower of yours too long, it's bad for your character. Come down and let out some of that hot air - it's good for you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Better not blink, old windbag.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: What are the two of us... but a pair of old windbags?
It's hard to imagine. Even the old Patriot can die.
Should I laugh? Should I shed a couple tears?
What's really funny is now that he's dead, you climbed all the way to the top of Reunion, second only to the Leader.
Ah, you've really outdone yourself. You should give yourself a pat on the back, W.
*clap* *clap*
Why do we cry? Because even he is dead. Ahh, alas, poor Patriot!
What thoughts went through his head as he died, and what was it like? Did he die on his feet or on his knees? If even he can die, then who among us can live?
Maybe he was the most likely to die.
Never knew how to keep a low profile. Only knew how to cling to a vague ideal. On this path he walked and walked, until everyone around him was gone. And then, he could finally rest in peace.
How sad.
Wait, doesn't that sound a bit like you, W?
Ehh? How am I anything like that?
W, don't lie to yourself. You're practically the same.
Nah, I never lie to myself. I'll never become like Patriot, because I can't.
I just can't.
Besides, death was... kind of a release for him, right?
But not for you, W. Death is the game of your life.
What doesn't kill you, puts you one step closer to death.
The closer you get to death... the closer you also get to madness.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Thanks, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I dunno how I would've gotten out of that trash heap without you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh yeah, Talulah...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Can you hear me, Talulah? Knock knock?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Forget it, it's no big deal. I just wanted to let you know...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ——I'm back.
